fusions.name: Hairline Thrust
fusions.desc: A thrown strike that deals 34 damage, ignoring the target's armour, and up to 1.5 times as much at maximum range. Its damage rises +10% per 10 tiles you have travelled (max +40%).

fusions.name: Gap Seeker
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles to the target and deals 14 damage, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Threaded Step
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 5 tiles forward. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Finding the Gap
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 25% of the target's armour. Your other abilities come round 5% sooner.
